body: My ign is AsianMexican. I was banned for combat logging but I really didn't combat log. I was being clumsy and I fell out the world and I really didn't feel like waiting respawn. But I never got shot or got hit by anyone and logged on them.

title: Appeal for (Combat logging)

replies.author: Vobaseball12
replies.body:
Unless the evidence shows that you actually combat logged, the way you described it is considered void logging. Either way, they kinda mean the same thing, and both are against our rules. 

Hope I cleared this up. :)

replies.author: zbd
replies.body:
After analyzing the video with some of my friends. I was told that logging off while falling into the void without contact of the opposing team was considered combat logging, which was where i was at fault due to the fact that I was unaware of this. Now that I know, I will cease to continue this action and I will follow the rules!
-AsianMexican

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hey AsianMexican,

I appreciate your honesty about your actions, but you have been given several previous infractions both for combat logging and other offenses, in addition to the fact that it is your job to learn the rules, either by asking a staff member or reading them on the forums or in-game. I ask that you wait a few months before appealing again without causing other troubles on the server to show that you will not break any more rules and that you have learned from your mistakes. 

Regards,
Rinn | Senior Moderator
